items.text:
i reeeeaaaalllly thought, this is going to be some "arty"game here...but its not....its a very annoying, strange idea of a game-mechanic, which is very bad....the "cut-scene-game" is just ♥♥♥♥ and the voice-acting...mm...its not bad, but its not good.

refund :)
items.text_zh:
我确确确确确实实以为，这会是个什么“文艺”游戏……但并不是……它是个非常烦人的、奇怪的游戏机制点子，非常糟糕……这个“过场动画游戏”简直就是♥♥♥♥，还有配音……嗯……不算差，但也不算好。

退款 :)
